cacheContract.provisioning: Copy verified bytes from a pinned model source; validate SHA-256 before startup; never commit traineddata

database.algorithm: catalog-v1; sorted C collation name=value; UTF8 SHA256; public tables/constraints/indexes/functions, public+storage RLS, public table grants; excludes only trimax_release_runtime itself

workerConfiguration.credentialScope: ocr-only; canonical reads, snapshot reads, own leased diagnostic/job writes; no business writes

requirements.liveDatabaseAttestation: Candidate SQL is not installed; startup must fail closed until separately reviewed
requirements.physicalAcceptance: Only installed-iPhone production evidence for exact release may pass; replay cannot pass
requirements.legacyModelCache: /tmp/tesseract-cache actual resolved traineddata path needs explicit attestation; not silently assumed
